scope.summary: Extend the foundation read scaffold (MT-007) to the full structured backend read surface required by STU-MDL-001: the scene/layer-graph tree, selectors by id/kind/name, semantic diffs between two document states, and structured render receipts. A model MUST be able to inspect the FULL Studio document and tool surface from the API alone, without screen-reading and without source-app knowledge.
acceptance_criteria: full backend read surface: tree, selectors, semantic diffs, render receipts; API-only inspection
expected_tests: live: read API returns layer-graph tree + selectors by id/kind/name
live: semantic diff between two document states
test: full document inspectable from API alone (no screen-read)

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

target_entries: Studio / Model API / Reading the document (model layer)

risk_if_missed: Models cannot fully inspect the document/tool surface from the API; steerability incomplete.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
